en.title: A Descriptive Report on Semantic Drift within the Narrative Model and the Trajectory of Non-Stationary Flying Ships
en.premise: After the world transitioned from physical constants to a descriptive "Narrative Model," concepts materialized, and voids devoid of meaning began to expand. Upon the world's boundary, maintained by the function of Hermann—a former Annotator—"conceptual migratory birds" without physical substance have begun an abnormal migration. As an investigator, "I" board a remnant of description known as a "Flying Ship" to drift through semantic storms and track the world's descriptive errors, striving to bind unfinished stories together.

zh.title: 关于故事模型中的语义漂移与非定常飞行船航迹的描述报告
zh.premise: 当世界从物理常数迁移至描述论的“故事模型”后，概念开始实体化，而缺失意义的空白地带正不断扩大。在曾成为“注脚者”的赫尔曼之函数所维持的世界边界上，不具备物理实体的“概念候鸟”开始了异常的回游。作为调查员的“我”，为了将未完的故事连接在一起，乘坐着在语义风暴中漂流的、被称为“飞行船”的描述残骸，追踪着世界的描述错误（Error）。
